Name: Crystal Mini-Obelisks for AT
Author: Morghoula
Description:
[b][size=4][color=#674ea7]Looking for a more witchy, crystal-core aesthetic for your playthrough? These gemstones are filled with wild magic that can teleport you around your farm![/color]

[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/KjG9ptb/features.png[/img]
[list]
[*]8 different colors of crystals
[*]2 versions of each crystal color: plain, and a version that comes with a stand to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables﻿[/url]﻿
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/XYdBFhX/installation.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Download Alternative Textures and this mod and extract to your Mods folder
[*]Buy the [b]Paint Bucket[/b] from Robin's shop (comes with AT) and use on a crafted "Mini-Obelisk" to see available options﻿ (TIP: you can easily find them by searching for the keywords 'crystal' or 'Sevinae')
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/CzCSKf2/recommended-mods.png[/img]﻿[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables﻿[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7900]Multiple Mini-Obelisks[/url]﻿ (so that you can have more than 2 on your farm if you wish)
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (AT) Crystal Mini Obelisks
